ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var all = [];
var m = baseUrl.match(/\/xiaoshuo\/(\d+)\/(\d+)\/(\d+)?\/?$/);
if (m) {
  var base = 'https://m.gdpsw.com/xiaoshuo/' + m[1] + '/' + m[2] + '/';
  for (var p = 1; p <= 200; p++) {
    var u = (p === 1) ? base : base + p + '/';
    var h = '';
    try { h = String(java.ajax(u)); } catch (e) { break; }
    if (h.indexOf('class="chapter"') < 0) { break; }
    var as = org.jsoup.Jsoup.parse(h).select('ul.chapter li a');
    if (as.size() === 0) { break; }
    for (var i = 0; i < as.size(); i++) { all.push(as.get(i)); }
  }
}
var out = new Packages.org.jsoup.select.Elements();
for (var j = all.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) { out.add(all[j]); }
out;
</js>
